description: The Americana-styling gives authenticity and theme to this highly distinctive leisure throw. Made of 100% polyester fabric, the rustic treatment of the faux-leather finish on the front side, coupled with the cozy softness of the faux lambswool Sherpa on the inside, is a fashionable masterpiece. The “bonus” feature is the concealed zipper corner pocket which not only allows for quality embroidery, but acts as a storage compartment for remotes/cell phones/keys, for those nights when it’s just too cold to leave the warm confines of the blanket.
